article.story: NORMAL, Ill. -- — Malik Moore’s 20 points helped Illinois State defeat Bellarmine 76-59 on Tuesday. Moore also had 14 rebounds and seven assists for the Redbirds (2-3). Chase Walker scored 17 points and added seven rebounds. Mason Klabo shot 3-for-9 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. Tyler Doyle led the way for the Knights (1-5) with 16 points and two steals. Illinois State took the lead with 14:50 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Moore led his team in scoring with 12 points in the first half to go up 36-24 at the break. Illinois State extended its lead to 47-26 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. Klabo scored a team-high eight points in the second half to close out the win. Up next Illinois State has a Thursday home matchup with Eureka. Bellarmine visits Eastern Kentucky on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
